points.description: States that a variable is a location in memory (equivalent wording such as a named storage location or a place in memory is acceptable).
States that the location can store a value (equivalent wording such as holding or containing a data value is acceptable).

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating both that a variable is a memory location and that it stores a value, in any equivalent wording. Award P1 only if the student identifies a memory location, not just a container or label without reference to memory. Award no marks for a definition that omits memory or the stored value, or that describes only the name of a variable.
